# Vocabulary: agency_model

How player intent reaches the simulation. A game may use several.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `direct-avatar` | Direct avatar | Player moves and acts as one character in real time. |
| `direct-unit` | Direct unit control | Player selects and commands specific units or agents. |
| `indirect-incentive` | Indirect incentive | Agents act autonomously; player shapes outcomes via environment, priorities, or incentives. |
| `zoning-placement` | Zoning / placement | Player places structures or designates areas; agents fill them. |
| `policy-parameter` | Policy / parameter | Player sets rates, laws, budgets, or sliders that change system rules. |
| `order-queue` | Order queue | Player issues designations or jobs that agents pick up in priority order. |
| `programmatic` | Programmatic | Player writes code, circuits, or scripts executed by the simulation. |
| `design-then-test` | Design then test | Player builds a configuration offline, then runs the sim to evaluate it. |
| `conversational` | Conversational | Player acts through free-text or voice language parsed by the system. |
| `caretaking-interaction` | Caretaking interaction | Player performs discrete care actions (feed, clean, play) on a creature or person. |
| `supernatural-intervention` | Supernatural intervention | Player casts powers or miracles that alter terrain, weather, or beings. |
